curriculum.subject: English Language Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: value the importance of comprehension in lifelong learning.

mission.title: value the importance of comprehension in lifelong learning.

interactions.prompt: Read: Akinyi has a red bag. What colour is the bag?
interactions.feedback: Yes! Understanding the sentence helped you find red.
interactions.retryHint: Read the sentence again and find the colour word.

interactions.prompt: Read: Wash your hands before eating. What should you do first?
interactions.feedback: Correct! Comprehension helps us follow useful instructions.
interactions.retryHint: The word before tells what comes first.

interactions.prompt: Match each short message to what it helps you know.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap a message, then tap what it helps you know.
interactions.feedback: Great! Understanding messages helps us learn and stay safe.
interactions.retryHint: Ask what each message teaches you.

interactions.prompt: Read: Plant the seed, add soil, then water it. Why is understanding this text useful?
interactions.feedback: Well done! Comprehension helps us complete tasks.
interactions.retryHint: Think about what the steps teach you to do.

interactions.prompt: A medicine label says: Take with an adult. Why must we understand it?
interactions.feedback: Exactly! Understanding important words can keep us safe.
interactions.retryHint: Choose the reason connected to the label.

interactions.prompt: Why is comprehension important throughout life?
choices: It helps us understand, learn, and act wisely.
It only helps us copy letters.
It stops us from asking questions.
interactions.answer: It helps us understand, learn, and act wisely.
interactions.feedback: Excellent! Comprehension supports learning every day.
interactions.retryHint: Choose the answer showing many ways understanding helps.
